message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday fell on a Friday or Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Dates | Provinces/Regions that Observe |
|---------|-------------|--------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Mon) | Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba (except Winnipeg), New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) | All provinces *except* Quebec |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) | All provinces *except* Quebec |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) | All provinces |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) | All provinces |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) | All provinces |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) | All provinces |

### Notes & Caveats

- **New Year’s Day** fell on Sunday, Jan 1, 2023. While it’s a statutory holiday everywhere, it didn’t create a long weekend unless you took Monday off.
- **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11) was on Wednesday, so it didn’t form a long weekend.
- **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) was on Tuesday, so it didn’t form a long weekend.
- **Family Day** and **Good Friday** are not observed in all provinces (e.g., Quebec doesn’t observe Good Friday; some provinces don’t observe Family Day). Adjust your planning accordingly if you’re in one of those regions.

---

#### How to Pull This Data Programmatically

If you’d like to fetch this data directly into your holiday‑planning app, you can use the `holidays` Python package:

```python
import holidays

canada_holidays = holidays.Canada(years=2023)
for date, name in sorted(canada_holidays.items()):
    print(date, name)
```

Or query an online service such as [Calendarific](https://calendarific.com/) or the official [Government of Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/finance/tax.html) holiday API.

Let me know if you need help integrating this into your app!
